annotations.title: Find free time in my Outlook calendar

description: Open slots of at least duration_minutes in YOUR Outlook calendar on weekdays between day_start and day_end, in time_zone. Busy = anything not marked free. Read-only. Sign-in required.

day_end.description: Working day end, HH:MM. Defaults to 17:00.

day_start.description: Working day start, HH:MM. Defaults to 09:00.

start_date.description: First day to check, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone for the times, e.g. America/Denver. Defaults to UTC.

name: find_outlook_free_time
title: Find free time in my Outlook calendar
